subject.title: [Bug]: Unscheduled reminder guard fires for isolated-session crons + counter lost during compaction

question: Should maintainers adopt or refresh the open fork PR that covers both reported gaps, or create a same-repo replacement that also coordinates with the partial compaction-counter PR?
rationale: The bug and fix shape are source-proven, but an exact full fix exists outside the target repo and the same-repo open PR only covers one variant, so automation should not create another competing branch without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt Or Replace Full Fix
options.body: Use the open fork PR as source material or open a narrow same-repo replacement covering both isolated-cron matching and compaction-counter preservation with regression tests.

options.title: Wait On Existing Fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to refresh it into a target-repo merge path.

options.title: Split By Variant
options.body: Land the partial compaction-counter PR separately and keep this issue open for the isolated-cron follow-up.

recommendation.title: Adopt Or Replace Full Fix
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as source material or open a narrow same-repo replacement covering both isolated-cron matching and compaction-counter preservation with regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior reminder-guard suppression PR and extracted the current guard helper, making them the best available owner for the adopt-or-replace decision.
